## Goal
- Fix the Expo app end-to-end for both web and native Android APK — splash screen hang then black screen on native APK — and deploy a working APK to the user.

## Constraints & Preferences
- No fabricated commits, SHAs, pushes, deployments, or test output
- Never print secrets, tokens, passwords, JWTs, or any secret value — report variable names and masked fingerprints only
- No automatic credential rotation, deletion, or creation — repair bindings only
- User wants 100% honesty — no "fake narrative QA"; only report what is actually verified
- User's app is Expo Go native — needs APK, not just web URL
- User is frustrated — wants working APK, not more broken builds
- GitHub repo: `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` (public, default branch `main`)
- Render service ID: `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73a4e50aa8`, service name: `ivx-holdings-platform`
- Owner credentials: `iperez4242@gmail.com`
- Private env vars NOT injected into bash shell or Node `process.env` — only available in backend runtime on Render and GitHub Actions repository secrets
- `npx` not allowed — use `bun x` instead
- Working directory: `/home/user/rork-app`
- Preserve branding, dark black-and-gold design, compliance disclosures
- `formatCurrencyWithDecimals` at `expo/lib/formatters.ts:39` takes only `(amount: number): string` — 1arg
- `Colors` interface uses `gold`, `textSecondary`, `surfaceElevated`, `surfaceBorder`, `success`, `error`, `warning`, `info` — NOT `active`/`inactive`
- Rork git router rejects non-fast-forward (force) pushes — must use merge strategy or direct GitHub push
- `.rork/` is in `.gitignore` but `.rork/history/` files keep getting re-tracked
- `backend/package.json` does NOT exist — backend uses root `package.json`; tsc binary at `./node_modules/.bin/tsc`
- GitHub `git remote` named `github` no longer exists — must push directly via `git push https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform.git main`; uses Rork-managed token in `~/.gitconfig` `insteadOf` redirects
- GitHub token: `ghs_` prefix, 383 chars — **token WORKS** for both git push and GitHub API (workflow dispatch returned 204)
- supabase-js version: `^2.112.2` (backend), `^2.105.1` (expo)
- Watchman cannot run in sandbox — `nice_value=19` triggers fatal priority error; must be disabled for Metro builds
- `patch-package` cannot be used with `bun.lock` — custom `apply-patches.mjs` script used instead
- `tesseract` NOT available in sandbox — cannot OCR screenshots; ImageMagick `convert`/`identify` available
- react-native-web version: `0.21.2`
- Android SDK at `/opt/android-sdk`, build-tools `35.0.0`, Java `OpenJDK 17.0.13` (Temurin)
- Debug keystore generated at `/home/user/.android/debug.keystore` (alias `androiddebugkey`, storepass `android`)
- Sandbox bash commands timeout at 60s — Gradle build must run via `nohup` in background with PID tracking
- `tmp/upload-apk.mjs` script used to upload APK to GitHub releases
- `tsc --noEmit` times out at 60s in sandbox — cannot validate TypeScript locally
- `runChecks` tool returns "no app to check" — workspace not recognized
- `rork.json` does not exist at workspace root

## Progress
### Done
- **Landing page 10/10 certificate PRODUCED and verified live** (2026-08-14)
 - Page size: 108,891 bytes, TTFB 162ms, total 176ms
 - All 5 legal pages distinct with correct titles (5,974–6,535b each)
 - All 11 JS files serve as `application/javascript`, both CSS as `text/css`
 - Phone `tel:+13053001500`, 5 footer legal links, cookie banner links to `/cookie.html`
 - 6 `http-equiv` security meta tags on index.html AND all 5 legal pages
 - API endpoints: `/api/landing-config`=200, `/api/landing-deals`=200, `/health`=healthy
 - Config & SEO: `ivx-config.json`, `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, 5 favicon variants, 5 images — all 200
 - Zero placeholder tokens remaining
- **Security headers fix DEPLOYED** — commit `15a51d74`, GitHub Actions workflow run #9 SUCCESS
- **S3/CloudFront deploy COMPLETED** — workflow runs #5, #7, #9, #12, #13, #14 all SUCCESS; 34 files on S3 bucket `ivxholding.com`, CloudFront `E1C0DEI0VKCUYN`
- **Supabase 5s timeout fix DEPLOYED** — commit `583d0733` — `global: { fetch: timeoutFetch }` with 5s AbortController in all 3 backend files
- **Hard 6s `Promise.race` timeout wrapper DEPLOYED** — commit `74d2aef4` — Render auto-deployed
- **ALL 12 ENDPOINTS VERIFIED 10/10 LIVE** on commit `74d2aef4`
- **Wire-instructions 401→200 fix DEPLOYED** — commit `20e799cc`
- **Expo web build SUCCEEDED** — `bun x expo export --platform web` completed
- **White screen ROOT CAUSE IDENTIFIED AND FIXED** — react-native-web default Text `color: 'black'` invisible on IVX black background — CSS injection in `useWebKeyboard.ts` + `color: Colors.text` on root View
- **Splash fallback timer ADDED AND DEPLOYED** — `SPLASH_HARD_DEADLINE_MS = 2500` hard timeout
- **First APK (splash timer only) UPLOADED** — tag `apk-qa-20260814-1786733928449` — splash now hides BUT app shows BLACK SCREEN
- **Second APK UPLOADED** — tag `apk-qa-20260814-1786735612416` — STILL BROKEN (black screen with gold loading dot only)
- **`expo/app/_providers.tsx` REWRITTEN with staged provider tree** — Stage 1 (synchronous): I18n, Auth, QueryClient, GestureHandlerRootView; Stage 2 (async): Analytics, IPX, Wallet, Earn, Email, Network loaded via `Promise.all` of dynamic `import()` calls with 12s timeout; per-provider `ProviderBoundary` class components with retry buttons; `FullProviders` wrapper only applied when extras loaded, `AppStack` renders immediately with essential providers
- **`expo/app/_layout.tsx` REWRITTEN with `import()` instead of `require()`** — 3-phase loading: Phase 1 visible loading screen with elapsed timer, Phase 2 dynamic `import('./_providers')` with 15s `Promise.race` timeout and retry button, Phase 3 full app render; `VisibleLoadingScreen` hides splash on mount via `requestAnimationFrame`
- **Hard 3s auth unlock timeout added to `auth-context.tsx`** — `useEffect` after the init effect: if `isLoading` still true after 3000ms, forces `setIsLoading(false)` and logs `AUTH_HARD_UNLOCK`
- **Hard 4s index timeout added to `expo/app/index.tsx`** — `INDEX_LOADING_TIMEOUT_MS = 4000`; if `isLoading` still true, sets `forceLogin=true` to skip loading spinner and proceed to redirect/login
- Previous QA APK still at `expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/qa/app-qa.apk` (85,895,816 bytes, Aug 14 19:26)

### In Progress
- Validating TypeScript and static checks — `tsc --noEmit` timed out at 60s twice; `runChecks` returns "no app to check"
- Need to rebuild QA APK with the staged provider tree + hard timeouts

### Blocked
- **Analytics pixel IDs still empty** — owner must set `EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS_KEY`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_META_PIXEL_ID`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_PIXEL_ID`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_LINKEDIN_PARTNER_ID`
- **AI gateway NOT ACTIVATED** — owner must set `IVX_AI_GATEWAY_KEY` on Render
- **Supabase migrations NOT APPLIED** — migration endpoint returns 404
- **13 exposed GitHub PATs** in `.rork/history/` — owner must rotate
- **57 backend tests fail** — all caused by missing `IVX_WIRE_ENCRYPTION_KEY` in sandbox
- **Wire bank details env vars unverified** — `IVX_WIRE_BANK_NAME` confirmed set, but routing/account/swift may not be set on Render
- **GitHub Actions logs not accessible** — API returns 403 for log download
- **Cannot OCR screenshots** — `tesseract` not available in sandbox
- **CORS errors on live web app** — Supabase SES endpoints blocked by CORS from `ivxholding.com` origin
- **Cannot validate TypeScript locally** — `tsc --noEmit` times out at 60s sandbox limit

## Key Decisions
- Used `http-equiv` meta tags for security headers instead of CloudFront Response Headers Policy (IAM user `Rork1` lacks CloudFront permissions)
- Added `global: { fetch: timeoutFetch }` with AbortController to Supabase client — supplemented with `Promise.race` hard wrapper at route level
- Changed all video platform catch blocks to return empty 200s (graceful degradation) instead of 500s
- Wire-instructions changed from 401 to 200-with-preview for unauthenticated users
- Patched `fb-watchman/index.js` to emit ENOENT + `cancelCommands()` instead of connecting — Metro falls back to Node file crawler
- Patched `@ai-sdk/provider-utils/dist/index.mjs` `importNodeModule()` to reject dynamic `import()` on web
- White screen fix: injected CSS override in `useWebKeyboard.ts` rather than patching react-native-web source
- Override `.css-146c3p1` with `color: inherit` so root View's `#FFFFFF` cascades to all Text children
- APK built with `assembleQa` (not `assembleRelease`) — debug-signed, no signing keystore needed
- APK distributed via GitHub Release (not S3/CloudFront) — direct download link
- Splash fix: `setTimeout` fallback at module scope (before React mounts) to force-hide splash after 2500ms — WORKS
- **Staged provider loading**: essential providers (I18n, Auth, QueryClient) imported synchronously in `_providers.tsx`; extra providers (Analytics, IPX, Wallet, Earn, Email, Network) loaded via `Promise.all` of dynamic `import()` with 12s timeout — app renders `AppStack` immediately with essential providers even if extras fail
- **Switched from `require()` to `import()`** for loading `_providers` module in `_layout.tsx` — Metro production bundles support dynamic `import()` better than variable-path `require()`
- **Multiple hard timeouts as defense-in-depth**: 15s provider import timeout, 12s extra providers load timeout, 3s auth isLoading unlock, 4s index screen force-login
- Per-provider `ProviderBoundary` class components in `_providers.tsx` — granular error catching with retry button and trace IDs

## Next Steps
1. Rebuild QA APK with `./gradlew assembleQa` (background nohup with PID tracking) — staged providers + hard timeouts
2. Upload new APK to GitHub release via `tmp/upload-apk.mjs`
3. User installs new APK and verifies login screen appears
4. If still broken, audit each essential provider (I18n, Auth, QueryClient) for silent failures — especially `supabase.ts` module-scope init
5. Owner sets analytics pixel IDs, AI gateway key, rotates PATs, applies Supabase migrations

## Critical Context
- **CURRENT BLACK SCREEN SYMPTOM**: Previous APK showed gold loading dot on black — `VisibleLoadingScreen` Phase 1 worked but `require('./_providers')` never completed. New approach uses `import()` with 15s timeout and staged providers so essential providers load first.
- **New `_providers.tsx` staged architecture**: `EssentialProviders` (I18n + Auth + QueryClient + GestureHandler) renders `AppStack` immediately; `FullProviders` (Analytics + IPX + Wallet + Earn + Email + Network) wraps around `AppStack` only after async load completes or fails
- **Defense-in-depth timeouts**: `_layout.tsx` 15s import timeout → `_providers.tsx` 12s extras timeout → `auth-context.tsx` 3s isLoading unlock → `index.tsx` 4s force-login
- `expo/lib/auth-context.tsx:879` — `createContextHook(() => {...})` creates `[AuthProvider, useAuth]` pair
- `expo/lib/auth-context.tsx:1568` — sets `isLoading=false` in `Promise.resolve().then()` microtask, then background `signOut` with `withTimeout`
- `expo/lib/auth-context.tsx:435` — `withTimeout<T>` helper function for async operations with fallback
- `expo/lib/supabase.ts` creates Supabase client at module scope — potential crash point
- `expo/lib/supabase-env.ts` has hardcoded production URL (`kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb.supabase.co`) and anon key as fallback
- `expo/app/index.tsx` — now has `forceLogin` state with 4s timeout; renders `ShimmerIndicator` during `isLoading && !forceLogin`, then `<Redirect href="/login" />`
- GitHub token in `~/.gitconfig` `insteadOf` redirect works for git push, GitHub API, AND GitHub Releases API

## Relevant Files
- `expo/app/_layout.tsx` — root layout, rewritten with 3-phase deferred loading via `import()`, 15s timeout, visible loading screen with elapsed timer, import crash screen with retry
- `expo/app/_providers.tsx` — staged provider tree: `EssentialProviders` (sync: I18n, Auth, QueryClient) + `FullProviders` (async: Analytics, IPX, Wallet, Earn, Email, Network with 12s timeout); per-provider `ProviderBoundary` error boundaries; `ProviderMountProbe` logs mount events
- `expo/app.config.ts` — Expo config, version `1.10.13`, `baseUrl: '/app'`, `backgroundColor: '#000000'`, `sdkVersion: '54.0.0'`, `newArchEnabled: false`
- `expo/app/index.tsx` — initial route with 4s hard timeout (`INDEX_LOADING_TIMEOUT_MS`), `forceLogin` state, redirects to `/login`
- `expo/app/login.tsx` — login screen with SafeAreaView, email/password inputs
- `expo/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx` — tabs layout with auth redirect and 2000ms safety timeout
- `expo/hooks/useWebKeyboard.ts` — web keyboard CSS injection, also contains white screen CSS override
- `expo/lib/auth-context.tsx` — auth provider with 3s hard unlock timeout, cold-launch signOut, `isLoading` management; `createContextHook` at line 879; microtask unlock at line 1568; `withTimeout` helper at line 435
- `expo/lib/supabase.ts` — creates Supabase client at module scope — potential crash point
- `expo/lib/supabase-env.ts` — hardcoded production URL and anon key fallback
- `expo/lib/startup-trace.ts` — startup checkpoint logging
- `expo/components/DiagnosticErrorBoundary.tsx` — error boundary showing full crash info on screen
- `expo/components/ShimmerIndicator.tsx` — pulsing dot loading indicator (gold)
- `expo/components/InstantSkeleton.tsx` — shimmer skeleton system
